data.description:
## Symptom

On 2026-11-16 (PST), `review_plan_start(sarcastic-specified-kodiakbear)` returned job `1794856602730588534-4009502f517c4b95a7044e9ac59e83ff` at 11:16 PST. The production MCP container logged `GATE_PEAK_RSS ... "ticket_id": "sarcastic-specified-kodiakbear", "elapsed_ms": 449638` at 1794857071 (about 11:24 PST), and `plan_review_status` reported `certified` (`signed_at` 1794857058838360399, `verified_at_sha` b4e0d01b649). Yet `gate_status(job_id)` kept returning `status: "running"`, `durable.verdict: "unsigned"` (reason "ticket has no signature") and `findings.readable: false, reason: run-running` on 13 polls over roughly 60 minutes, including polls made after the attestation existed.

## Impact

A caller that follows the documented poll protocol (wait for `gate_status` to reach `passed`/`failed`) waits indefinitely on a finished, already-signed review. This run's wait was about 60 minutes. Only `plan_review_status` showed the truth. The `durable` block inside `gate_status` also contradicted `plan_review_status` for the same ticket at the same time.

## Evidence not yet gathered

Whether the job-index record was never written, or was written but not read back (for example, an index held per worker or per container), has not been checked. The container was `rebar-mcp-b4e0d01b6491-8092`, up 2 days, with no blue-green flip during the run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Root cause identified and recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] After a plan review signs, `gate_status(job_id)` reports a terminal status and a `durable` block that agrees with `plan_review_status`; a regression test covers the failing path.
data.title: gate_status stays "running" for an hour after the plan review signed its attestation
